name: io.github.bugfender/mcp
title: Bugfender
description: Access Bugfender logs, crashes, devices, and user feedback from MCP-enabled clients.

environmentVariables.name: BUGFENDER_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bugfender API access token from MCP setup.

environmentVariables.name: BUGFENDER_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token for automatic session renewal (recommended).

environmentVariables.name: BUGFENDER_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL override; defaults to https://dashboard.bugfender.com/api
